name: Will my insurance cover hardwood floor water damage repair?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover hardwood floor water damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or an overflowing appliance. However, damage from neglected maintenance, gradual leaks, or flood damage (which requires a separate flood insurance policy) is typically not covered. It's essential to review your specific policy details and contact your insurance provider immediately after discovering the damage. A professional restoration company can often assist with documentation for your claim.
